name: Tiss of the Nets
source_profile: ● Tiss of the Nets (NG) is a respected eggkeeper and healer who has developed friendships with both Thalenweald elves and certain human fishing communities.
source_reference: Handbook v0.4, pp. 152–161; Legendarium v1.0, pp. 148–157; project NPC index; Legendarium v1.0, p. 54 (source excerpt; may be partial)
